sonnetLines: The silver gleam of passing years,
A whispered promise on the breeze.
We build our world through shared tears,
And find true solace and unease.
Let time forget its measured pace,
Before the morning breaks the spell.
A story that we know so well.
To drink deep from this fading cup,
And taste the salt of what remains.
I'll hold you close when shadows fall,
Before the curtain starts to call.
